set.body: Forward-review P0 against ADR 0001 D5/L1. align/hsmm.scala:123-140 exposes public HsmmResult/AblationResult shapes; matrix.scala:115 and 226 expose public AlignmentRow/AlignmentMatrix constructors and copies; signature.scala:52-58 accepts any HsmmResult as scientific input. Executable repro constructs HsmmResult(AlignmentMatrix(Vector(AlignmentRow(u, Map(Source(ref) -> 1.0)))), ..., admissibility = Map.empty): faithfulMass=1 with no gate record. The AblationResult type therefore does not make ungated output non-consumable. Acceptance: only GraphHsmm or a validator/codec that proves posterior states are a subset of recorded admissibility can create the scientific gated result; forged/copy-mutated rows cannot inhabit the accepted type; RecallSignature/population consumers require that proof; decoding validates the invariant; negative construction test and mutation law cover faithful/distorted/external states on JVM/JS/Native.
set.title: P0 align: make HsmmResult a non-forgeable proof of ModeGate admission
